question: Which divine qualities characterize the goddess of speech in whom refuge is taken?
premises: The speaker declares taking refuge in the goddess of speech.
The goddess is described as bearing bright radiance.
The goddess is described as three-eyed.
inference: Refuge is taken in the three-eyed goddess of speech who bears bright radiance.
plain_english: I take refuge in the goddess of speech, three-eyed and bearing a bright radiance.
